name: com.amenone.shadermodules
description: HLSL include files for Unity shaders: hashes and noises (value, simplex with gradient, voronoi, curl, domain warp), easing functions, uv transforms, time helpers, 2D fractals, zellige tile patterns, and blur helpers that let bilinear filtering average texels (downsample, upsample, separable gaussian).

samples.description: A URP unlit shader and a scene that switch each noise, fractal and zellige function on and off from the material. Needs URP.
GPU particles moved by a compute shader that includes noise.cginc (random and curl_noise), drawn with Graphics.RenderMeshIndirect. Needs URP and compute shader support.
A compute shader that averages the alpha of a texture per block and shows the result on a RawImage. Does not use the include files. Needs uGUI and compute shader support.

A URP Renderer Feature (RenderGraph) that blurs the whole camera color by halving it with blur_downsample_center5 a set number of times and enlarging it back with blur_upsample. Needs Unity 6 and URP.
